findings.rule: D40/D47 labels never break inside a word; 275-c7
findings.trigger: At 337dp and font scale 2.0 the Contact email (e.g. priya.deshmukh@gmail.com, 24 chars at bodySmall x2) is a single plain Text word wider than the ~277dp card content, so it breaks mid-word; the same applies to a long role title/organisation word, a long skill chip and an unbroken name. Only banner, Add date, source line and CTA use whole-word fitting or are asserted.
findings.title: Contact, role, education and chip text can still break mid-word at font 2.0
findings.proof: ReviewLayoutTest: at NARROW_DEVICE font scale with freshReviewProfile(), assert lines of the email text end at a word boundary (fails today).

findings.rule: I.1 / D74 never confirm unseen facts
